27/S0.subgoal: Explain why knowledge of visual perception is crucial for designing extended reality systems.

27/S1.subgoal: Describe the three different models (particle, wave, and ray) used to define light.

27/S2.subgoal: Explain how light interacts with materials (transmission, absorption, reflection) and how the color of a scene is perceived.

27/S3.subgoal: Describe the physical components of the human eye and the roles of photoreceptors, rods, and cones.

27/S4.subgoal: Relate color perception to the visible light spectrum and the excitation of photoreceptors.

27/S5.subgoal: Compare and contrast central and peripheral vision and explain the phenomenon of the blind spot.

27/S6.subgoal: Summarize the concepts covered and outline how this knowledge will be applied to understanding display and headset systems.
